recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the original FHIR-I clarification for the remaining in-core $everything operation that uses the same patient-compartment return rule, while avoiding edits to the externally maintained Patient/$everything definition.
issue_request: FHIR-26638 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested explicit $everything behavior for version-specific references. The resolution said to add that the server SHOULD resolve version-specific references by returning the explicitly named version.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by commit 4bca361455ad0d5cf3a467b64e43d4915745da8c, which added the approved sentence to source/patient/operationdefinition-Patient-everything.xml. That Patient operation was later removed from core, while the same patient-compartment referenced-resource rule remained in the active core Group/$everything operation without the clarification.
additional_context: The paired Zulip discussions for FHIR-26637 and FHIR-26638 agreed that $everything should explicitly follow version-specific references, with SHOULD rather than SHALL. FHIR-I minutes recorded the 12-0-0 FHIR-26638 motion. Current core now links Patient/$everything to the Admin IG, and the external Patient/$everything XML still includes the approved sentence, so the core fix is limited to Group/$everything. Group is active in source/fhir.ini and source/group/list-Group-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/Group-everything.
reconciliation: Changed source/group/operationdefinition-Group-everything.xml to add the approved sentence immediately after the existing rule to return patient-compartment resources and referenced resources.
source_changes: source/group/operationdefinition-Group-everything.xml: added 'The server SHOULD resolve version-specific references by returning the explicitly named version.' to the Group/$everything description.

related_jiras.note: Paired Published issue from the same discussion for version-specific references in _include; useful context but it affects search semantics rather than this $everything source fix.
